propositions: Rename the transition command's --force-close flag to --force for consistency with the claim command's force flag spelling

The new --force flag must dispatch differently based on target status: bypass start-work/plan-review gate for open->in_progress, and bypass completion-verification/signature gate for transitions to closed
The parser must explicitly reject --force-close (with or without value) by raising CommandError naming --force, rather than silently skipping it as an unknown token

A bare --force on close transitions must record the reason as '(no reason given)', and --force=<reason> must set the close reason; --force --reason=X on open->in_progress must preserve X as the audit note

Tree-wide flag references in code, docs, and tests must migrate in the same change, with the retired spelling appearing only in frozen experiment corpora, CHANGELOG, release-notes, the parser's rejection branch, and its test
